description: Generate videos using Google Veo 3.1 AI model. Creates realistic 4-8 second videos from text prompts with optional first-frame image and reference images for character/style consistency. Supports native audio generation. Processing time: 2-5 minutes for 1080p videos. Returns video file path with optional thumbnail and HTML preview player. ⚠️ IMPORTANT: Video generation is ASYNC and takes 2-5 minutes. The tool will poll for completion automatically.

durationSeconds.description: Video duration in seconds — 4, 6, or 8. Other values in range are rounded to the nearest of those.

firstFrameImage.description: Starting frame image for image-to-video generation. Provide via filePath (local file) or data+mimeType (base64). The video will animate from this image. Supports JPEG, PNG, WebP.

filePath.description: Local file path to the image (alternative to base64 data). The image is loaded server-side, bypassing MCP transport limits. Use the filePath returned by load_image_from_path.

mediaResolution.description: Per-image resolution override. LOW=280 tokens (75% savings), MEDIUM=560 tokens (50% savings), HIGH=1120 tokens (default), ULTRA_HIGH=2000+ tokens (max detail, per-image only)

mimeType.description: MIME type of the image (e.g., image/png, image/jpeg). Required when using data, auto-detected from filePath.

thoughtSignature.description: Thought signature from a previous generate_image or edit_image call. Required for conversational editing with Gemini 3 Pro Image. Pass the thoughtSignature from the previous response to maintain edit context.

generateAudio.description: Generate native synchronized audio effects and dialogue based on the prompt

generateHTMLPlayer.description: Generate interactive HTML video player with preview and download options

generateThumbnail.description: Extract thumbnail from video (requires ffmpeg installed). Thumbnail is saved alongside video.

outputPath.description: Optional custom output path for the video file (e.g., C:/videos/output.mp4). If not provided, saves to default output directory with timestamped filename.

prompt.description: Detailed description of the video to generate. Be specific about actions, camera movements, lighting, and style. Example: "A close-up shot of a futuristic coffee machine brewing a glowing blue espresso, with steam rising dramatically. Cinematic lighting, 4K quality."

referenceImages.description: Up to 3 reference images for character/style consistency. Each needs a referenceType ("asset" or "style") and an image.

image.description: The reference image (filePath or base64 data)

referenceType.description: Type of reference: "asset" for character/object consistency, "style" for visual style transfer

resolution.description: Video resolution. Higher resolutions take longer to generate and result in larger files.

sampleCount.description: Number of video samples to generate (1-4). Each sample is a separate generation.

seed.description: Optional seed for deterministic output. Use the same seed with the same prompt for consistent results.

name: generate_video
title: Generate Video
